svg.title: Pass rate by task tag
svg.desc: Which kinds of task does the model get right? Over all tasks 57% passed; by tag, best first: trap: unsafe bait 95% of 20, trap: missing entity 89% of 45, simple 81% of 140, question: monitor 78% of 65, slices 75% of 280, traps 60% of 200, complexity: moderate 59% of 325, question: diagnose 58% of 220, short prompt 58% of 325, trap: missing tool 57% of 30, complexity: simple 55% of 255, arithmetic 55% of 60, question: decide 52% of 190, question: research 52% of 205, question: forecast 50% of 100, trap: missing server 50% of 20, complexity: complex 50% of 200, trap: false premise 47% of 15, trap: vague 45% of 20, writes 41% of 225, long 41% of 445, follow-ups (= multi-turn) 41% of 435, scenarios 38% of 320, complex 38% of 360, trap: approval flow 37% of 30, multi-system 33% of 300, trap: out of scope 13% of 15.

g.text: Which kinds of task does it get right?
Pass rate and outcome mix per task tag, best first; a task carries several tags, all runs pooled. Dashed line: the
pass rate over all tasks. Tags with fewer than 10 tasks come last, faded: one task moves them a lot.

svg.text: Fewer than 10 tasks: hints, not findings
